title: Field between parallel plates
caution: This holds only when the plate separation is much smaller than the plate dimensions, away from the edges, and with no dielectric between the plates: 10.4.A.4 has the field between the plates of an isolated parallel-plate capacitor decrease when a dielectric is inserted. It follows from Gauss's law with the principle of superposition (10.3.A.3.i), and the field is proportional to the surface charge density on either plate (10.3.A.3.ii).
ced_evidence: 10.3.A.3.i "magnitude of the electric field between two charged parallel plates... determined by applying Gauss's law and the principle of superposition"; 10.3.A.3.ii
